title: 45 Hazelwood, Taylors Hill, Galway, H91H5RN
description:
*****VIRTUAL TOUR AVAILABLE****

DNG  Leonard & Heaslip are delighted to offer to the market an outstanding luxury detached home in one of Galway’s most exclusive and sought after locations. No 45 Hazelwood, set just off the Taylor's Hill road, is one of the most impressive detached family residences to come to the Galway market this year. Built in 1996, this impressive property approximately 204sqm of well-proportioned, bright and spacious, living accommodation, which is finished to the highest standards. Set on a large corner site in a quiet quiet cul-de-sac, this luxurious family home is being sold to include many features including extensive tiling, hardwood floors, a fully integrated kitchen, conservatory, converted attic and externally, a large corner site with side access and private rear garden. 

Wonderfully presented, this owner-occupied property is close to all amenities and is within a short stroll of Galway city centre. Hazelwood is a mature and quiet residential estate of detached homes with generous open green space. There are multiple schools, both primary and secondary, all within a 10-minute walk, as are numerous recreational facilities.  For those seeking a detached home in a hugely desirable location with all conveniences close to hand, the search may be over. Viewing is essential and is strictly by appointment only. 

Features:
Wonderfully presented family home
Comprising approximately 2,200t² 
Highly efficient C rated home. 
New Boiler
PVC double glazed windows
Oil fired central heating
Coverted attic 
Landscaped low-maintenance rear garden 
Large side gate access
Cobblelock paved parking area
Excellent local amenities
Close distance to Salthill and Galway City 
On a regular bus route
